summary: HDFC Bank Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the retirement of Mr. Bhavesh Zaveri as Executive Director, effective April 18, 2026. The Board noted his retirement and appreciated his long service. No stake, price, premium, or advisor was involved. This is a routine director retirement disclosure for a foreign private issuer, reported on Form 6-K (equivalent to a U.S. 8-K for material events). The filing confirms a planned management succession without any special-situation transaction. What to watch: potential future leadership changes or strategic shifts under new management.
